messages:
maya: Noticing lots of Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1c since ~10:10 UTC. Tiny pods (~0.1 GPU) bouncing, eviction spikes. cc @devin

devin: Checking. I see `gpu-maint:NoSchedule` taint applied to 4 nodes in rack ap-southeast1c at 10:08. That selector shouldn't have matched c rack. Eviction rate ~5/min.

anika: I pushed a selector tweak for maintenance rollouts last night to allow simple regexes. Looks like `rack=ap-southeast1.*` matched c as well. My fault.

maya: Result is classic fragmentation cascade: tiny pods are scattered; once nodes get tainted they requeue and autoscaler spins warm nodes which then get tainted again -> oscillation and cost spike.

infra-sre: Cost estimate: extra warm spins ~= 2.1 GPU-hrs in last 20m. Warm start ~5m. Recommend pausing regional autoscaler and untainting affected nodes as short-term fix.

devin: I'll remove taints on the four nodes and watch eviction controller. Command:

```
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r20 gpu-maint:NoSchedule-  # repeat for r21,r22,r23
```

Pausing autoscaler for ap-southeast1.

ops-bot: Incident bot: Eviction surge acknowledged by devin at 10:18 UTC. Autoscaler paused.

maya: Untaints applied. Pending queue started draining in ~90s; eviction rate fell to ~0.6/min.

anika: I'll revert the selector change and add a strict canary: single-rack test + checks (pending/gpu < 15, eviction_rate < 1/min) before wider rollout. Also adding a blacklist so maintenance never picks racks with >50% tiny-pod occupancy.

infra-sre: I'll author a short runbook: rollback taint -> pause autoscaler -> verify no driver/kernel faults -> safe-reapply via canary. Also add a cost-hedge alert: page if warm-pool scale >1.5x baseline for >10m.

devin: Leaving autoscaler paused for 15m. If evictions rebound i'll escalate.

maya: Postmortem items: fix selector, add frag-guard, add cost alert, and consider scheduler tweaks to prefer fractional packing for tiny pods.

ops-bot: Alert cleared: Eviction rate normalized. Incident logged as 2026-03-23-apse1c-selector-overreach. :white_check_mark:
